title: Bad nginx deploy
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the web component (nginx), the deployment‑related problem, and the trigger as the new nginx version.
root_cause: The 500 errors started after deploying nginx:1.28, which introduced an upstream timeout configuration that caused API connection timeouts. This version change is the direct trigger of the errors.
truth: The new nginx version 1.28 introduced a regression that causes it to return 500 Internal Server Error for all requests.
